_about: Every AI presenter. ONE list, read by src/lib/presenters.ts (server) and src/components/presenter-picker.js (browser, fetched from /src/public/presenter-catalogue.json). docs/video-producer-screen-walkthrough-plan.md §11.3 (Phase A1, decision D-A2: 12 to start, 6 female and 6 male, mixed ages and backgrounds, all made up). Every face was drawn by FLUX.2 Pro from a written description (scripts/make-presenters.mjs) and checked by eye: none is a real person and none is named after one. `voices.en` is the presenter's own English voice; every other language uses the catalogue voice of the same gender (presenterVoice). `face` is the full-size picture the avatar model is given; `thumb` and `sample` (a 5-second English hello, made once with Kling AI Avatar v2 Standard) are what the picker shows, so choosing a presenter never spends anything.
